svg.text: INMP441 + existing ST7735 screen + ESP32-CAM + MB • proposed run wiring
Match printed pin names. This is a hole map, not a physical pin-orientation drawing.
USB OFF while wiring. ESP32-CAM sits BESIDE the MB, not seated in it.
MB supplies 5V and GND only. MB serial connections must be absent during microphone use.
PUT ONE JUMPER END IN EACH LISTED HOLE
Each row A–E is one electrical group. F–J is separate. Nothing bridges the center gap.
Keep both SD slots empty. Leave IO16 and IO4 unused. Remove the old analog microphone.
TFT power/backlight: retain the existing working 3.3V wiring for your previously identified module.
New I²S firmware is required. The currently installed analog recorder cannot test this microphone.
